policy.resources: Each Android string resource (android/app/src/main/res/values) that carries a browser message's English maps to that message's key: tools/cross-platform/android-strings.mjs checks the English is still exactly the browser's and writes the translations (values-*/) from web/public/l10n. Mapped by role as well as words: equal English for a different control is declined with a reason. Arguments list the message's ICU arguments in %1$s, %2$s order; every argument is text the host formats as the browser does (a number as `{n, number}`), and a plural's form is chosen by its integer quantity.
policy.english: Resources no browser message carries. They stay English in every language, as a message missing from the browser's catalogue does, until the browser has a message for them.
policy.kotlin: Kotlin literals of the app that carry a browser message's words, kept in Kotlin for the reason named; the generator checks each still says exactly what the browser says. A new one fails until it becomes a mapped resource or is recorded here.
policy.declined: Equal English that is not the same message: never mapped, and never reported again while its words are unchanged.

reasons.model: Status text a ViewModel or workflow composes off the composition; it holds no Resources, and the text is checked through it.
reasons.tested: Platform-free words the JVM tests check through the class that composes them (PrepareFlowTest, SendFlowTest).

declined.reason: The send dialog's File fact names the G-code file sent, not the browser's File menu or action group.
Prepare's Filament picker names the filament preset, not the catalogue's Filament group (a menu's section heading).
The preview's View chooser names its colour mode, not the browser's View menu or action group (the camera views).
The virtual-filament row's Edit button is a verb on that filament, not the browser's Edit menu or action group.
The settings panel's Advanced mode (Simple, Advanced, Develop) is not the catalogue's Advanced group (a menu's section heading; de: Erweiterte Einstellungen).
The virtual-filament dialog's Add submits the new filament, not the browser's Add menu.
The send dialog's Plate fact is not the XR tool rail's Plate group, whose upstream translations name an action (de: Aktuelle Platte drucken, print the current plate).
The Simplify panel's Preview decimates the model to show the result (a verb); the browser's Preview messages name the G-code Preview area and its mode.
The Delete key, as Delete Selected's menu shortcut names it (DomShell's shortcutHint, untranslated in the browser too), not the toolbar's Delete action.

The settings panel's Cancel drops its draft (GeneratedSettingsPanel writes it untranslated); the browser's translated Cancels keep editing past the unsaved-changes guard, dismiss a dialog or close the XR keypad.
The settings panel's Apply commits every draft at once (GeneratedSettingsPanel writes it untranslated); the XR keypad's Apply enters the one value it typed.

The settings panel's Unavailable badge marks a field the generated schema cannot edit (GeneratedSettingsPanel writes it untranslated); the command palette's, the shell's and the XR menu's mark an action that cannot run now.
The Variable Layer Height panel's Reset restores default layer heights, not the Wave Overhangs panel's Reset.
The Variable Layer Height panel's Reset restores default layer heights, not the XR Wave Overhangs panel's Reset.
The storage delete confirmation's Delete button deletes a file from the printer's storage, not the canvas Delete Models action.
